questions.question: Which layout for the settings screen? Each one uses the accent `#38bdf8` on ink `#0f172a`.

options.label: Sidebar (Recommended)
options.description: Sections in a sidebar, accent `#38bdf8` on the picked one.
options.preview:
```html preview width=400 height=200
General
Account
Notifications
Advanced

General

Launch at login
Show in menu bar
Play sounds
``` Room for more sections later. Costs 112 px of width on every page.

options.label: Tabs
options.description: Tabs across the top, underlined in `#38bdf8`.
options.preview:
```html preview width=400 height=200
GeneralAccountNotificationsAdvanced
Launch at login
Show in menu bar
Play sounds
``` Familiar from macOS. Four tabs fit at this width; a fifth would crowd it.

options.label: Single column
options.description: Grey `#7f7f7f` headings and a `#38bdf8` Save button.
options.preview:
```html preview width=400 height=240

General

Launch at loginTheme

Account

EmailPlanPersonal
``` Everything on one scrolling page, laid out with CSS grid. Simplest; gets long past three sections.
